title: Chadic languages - Wikipedia

title: Dghwede | Ethnologue Free
text: Dghwede is a stable indigenous language of Nigeria. It belongs to the Afro-Asiatic language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
